data.body: Bug Bfeb62112d9: Ctx.repo is the primary (repo_root via --git-common-dir), and setup/adopt write every file under it, so adopt from a worktree dirtied the primary (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .mcp.json, .gitattributes, docs/ddflow) and left the caller's branch with nothing; it also judged .claude/commands/implement.md by the primary's copy. Fix: api.setup takes called_from; files are written into the caller's own tree (--show-toplevel); the log (.ddflow/events under the primary) and the hooks (git common dir) are unchanged. CLI passes called_from; the init report's commit hint and rules check look at that tree. Regression test: adopt from a linked worktree leaves the primary's git status clean and writes into the worktree; fails on current code. MCP ddflow_setup wiring needs surfaces/mcp.py (held by B-fix-asagent-tree).

data.body: Bug B695d7925bf. _install_one refuses over any foreign hook with 'Add this line to it yourself'. For a hook carrying the pre-commit framework header: if armed() says the framework already runs ddflow's check at that stage, report that and install nothing (not a refusal); otherwise refuse with the config-side remedy armed() already computes (a repo: local hook in the config named by the hook's ARGS line; ddflow precommit proposes one), never the generated file. --force unchanged. Regression test: generated hook + config without ddflow entries -> refusal names .pre-commit-config.yaml and not 'Add this line to it yourself'; with ddflow entries -> exit 0 and nothing overwritten. Fails on current code.
data.title: hooks install over a pre-commit-framework hook advises a repo: local hook in .pre-commit-config.yaml, not an edit the next pre-commit install discards, and does not refuse when the framework already runs ddflow's check (fixes bug B695d7925bf)

data.body: Bug Ba11a054309: run_nemo_run's driver copies missed the docs gate line and the ddflow wait guidance and doctor said Healthy. (1) services.adopt.driver_drift: on an adopted project, implement-phase.md and each present delta this ddflow ships, compared byte-for-byte with templates/drivers; doctor adds one NOTE naming them with the refresh remedy. (2) services.adopt.refresh_docs: rewrites implement-phase.md, the deltas already present, the managed AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md blocks and the adopted agents' native rules -- nothing else. CLI 'adopt --refresh-docs', MCP ddflow_setup refresh_docs; the rules-drift doctor line names it too, since plain adopt also rewrites MCP launches. Regression test: lagging drivers -> doctor names them (fails today); refresh rewrites them and leaves .mcp.json and the hooks byte-identical.
data.title: doctor notes driver docs that differ from the templates the running ddflow ships, and 'ddflow adopt --refresh-docs' (ddflow_setup refresh_docs) rewrites only the driver docs and rules blocks -- no MCP launch, hook or command-file changes (fixes bug Ba11a054309)
